unsupported.why: Neither cited source states the general rule that the lane 'never reads source-system production data'. feat.tasks only says to build on synthetic v3 rows, and the brief says nothing about production data. The rule appears in the agent's own definition (.claude/agents/data-engineering.md: 'synthetic data only; never source-system production data'), which is not cited. The citation therefore does not support this statement.

Section 2 counts the `dev` and `main` branches as 'environments'. No source defines deployment environments for ap_pipeline. Say that this is the agent's reading and that the tool view is repository-wide.

The tool view reports permissions for the whole repository, not for the agent identity in each environment. Add a short note that granted access per environment was taken from that one repository-level line.

The Result row cites feat.tasks for 'no access request is needed'. The decisive source is tool:repo-access. feat.tasks only supports the conclusion that the tasks touch no external systems, which is fine but should be kept separate.
